finalText:
Suite is green now: 625/625 passing.

Root cause: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js` computed tax on the pre-discount amount (`cents * taxRate`) instead of the discounted amount, even though its own doc comment says tax should apply to what the customer actually pays. Fixed to `roundCents(discounted * taxRate)`, which resolved all 3 failures (all in the "order totals" suite — the only rows with both a non-zero discount and non-zero tax, which is exactly what exposed the ordering bug).
